source_policy: Five upstream Python files unchanged at pinned commit; project adapter separate; preserve Apache LICENSE and provenance NOTICE.
dependency_policy: Parent-managed .venv-mitra; includes loguru used by upstream Preprocessor. No AutoGluon install required for vendored core/preprocessor.

preprocessing.input: compact13 same named raw inputs as TabPFN budget experiment
preprocessing.categories: Train-only vocabulary: unknown0, missing1 including iterate __MISSING__ sentinel, known2+. Sentinel excluded from fitted vocabulary; None/pd.NA/NaN all map to1.
preprocessing.numerics: No new log/scaler. PreserveNaN into train-only upstream mean imputation; all-missing train columns prefill0 and upstream constant filter removes them.
preprocessing.upstream: quantile_transform=False, no feature/class shuffle or projection, random_mirror_x=True with isolated fixed numpy RNG; core quantile support-only.
preprocessing.mutation: encode/transform/core operate on copies; caller raw data and saved context remain unchanged.

precision.mps: torch.autocast mps bfloat16, matching official trainer; logits.float before softmax or full-head CE

inference.support: All context rows, no8192 cap or sampling
inference.query_independence: Official nonflash source support self-attention and query-to-support attention only; no query-query row attention. CPU test checks chunk equivalence.
inference.probabilities: First2 logits stable FP32 softmax; no threshold/weight tuning

persistence.reload_device: CPU default, explicit MPS override; engine is never pickled
persistence.validation: CPU tiny real upstream model roundtrip; fullsamebackend roundtrip belongs to resource probe

resource.data: Synthetic independent X/y only for4636/8693; no real holdout labels or scores
shapes: 4636total synthetic rows backward episode:3708support/928disjointquery, matching official fullouter episode dimensions
8693support x13 +128query forward; full final-data shape with syntheticlabels
resource.memory: MPS allocator fraction .65 of recommended maximum; record OS memory_pressure and allocator limit before loading model. No watermarks disabled. OOM/timeout failclosed, no context reduction.
resource.deadline: Per invocation1200seconds default; user/parent may predeclare via CLI before model load. SIGALRM interrupts Python; allocator limit is the main protection against kernel allocation pressure.
resource.timing: First and warmed repeat, fullfold chunk extrapolation labelled estimate, RSSmax and MPS snapshots (not peak). No accuracy/loss result reported.
resource.backward: One full-head10-class CE backward plus one disposable AdamW optimizer step (lr3e-7 first warmup update, wd.3, betas.9/.999, eps1e-8). Record two-moment optimizer state bytes, resources while states live, finite gradients/parameters and real weight change. Synthetic labels only. Modified engine discarded; original CPU checkpoint state is used for zero-shot roundtrip. Resource-only random disjoint partition matches official episode dimensions but is not formal training sampler. Support floor(4n/5), query min(ceil(n/5),1024); no inference context truncation. Official per-layer checkpointing use_reentrant=False.
resource.sourcefreeze: Copy adapter/tests/protocol/vendor and env versions before firstcheckpoint load; failedprobes save failed_inconclusive result and never become candidate score.
resource.seed_policy: Synthetic attributes/support labels and preprocessing use fixed42, independent of formalCVseed policy.

attention_backend.reason: Parent resource probe: original forward full4636/query128 succeeded19.41/18.18sec;3708support/928query backward failed SDPA allocation under unchanged.65 MPS cap. No accuracy was scored.
attention_backend.operation: Only long-sequence nonflash SDPA decomposed along independent batch dimension, chunk1; every chunk retains fullQ and fullK and the same full-key softmax denominator. Concatenate in original batch order, same output projection.
attention_backend.condition: max(Q_sequence_length,K_sequence_length)>512 and batch_dimension>1; otherwise original upstream implementation, so feature attention sequence14 stays vectorized.
attention_backend.training_memory: Each SDPA chunk individually torch.utils.checkpoint(...,use_reentrant=False), retaining default RNG preservation. Upstream per-layer checkpoint remains unchanged. This prevents all per-chunk attention matrices remaining saved together; actual memory improvement must be probed.
attention_backend.state: Same Q/K/V/O modules, weights, state_dict keys; installed onto reconstructed model via a project subclass. No changes to the5vendoredfiles.
attention_backend.cpu_validation: Official-vs-adapter self/cross attention forward, separate input and every parameter gradients; full2layerTab2D nestedcheckpoint parameter gradients; SDPA call-shape test verifies fullK and shortsequence vectorization.
attention_backend.resource_validation: Parent runs smallMPS first, then4636forward+completeAdamWstep, then8693fullsynthetic forward; OOM remains inconclusive without precision/context fallback.
attention_backend.small_probe: 650total rows yields520support/130query backward, so maxK>512 exercises chunked training path. A520total-row episode would miss the threshold in backward.
attention_backend.label_copy: Adapter clones support labels before upstream embedding, whose padding assignment is in-place even when padding is false. Same label values; prevents shared tensor version mutation across independent computation graphs.
